payload.description:
## Trigger

When a human on a team that installed only the tracker kit wants to know what is ready and what is holding the rest, I want one command to write a page they can open, so I can answer it without them reading JSON from a CLI.

SPEC.md section 4.3 requirement 10 already commits to this: 'a generated graph and a static board rebuilt on write'. A grep for html, mermaid or svg across .basicly/core/kit/tracker returns nothing, against a positive control that the same tree holds 21 modules and a working CLI. So the requirement is owed and unmet, and it is the last of the competitive claims with nothing behind it.

Section 15 rejects a web application, and this is not one. No server, no network, no third-party asset: one self-contained HTML file with inline CSS and an inline SVG, regenerated on demand, which is exactly what requirement 10 restated the claim to.

The graph must be bounded. This ledger holds 1367 records, and an SVG over all of them is unreadable and enormous, so the rendered subgraph is the dispatchable one - what is ready, what is blocked, and what blocks it - with the count rendered stated against the total on the page. A page that silently drew a subset would be worse than one that drew nothing.

## Acceptance Criteria

- One kit command writes a single HTML file that opens with no network and no other file beside it.
- The page shows the counts, the ranked ready set, what is blocked and what holds it, and every record with its status and what it owes.
- The page carries an inline SVG of the dispatchable dependency subgraph, and states how many records it drew against how many the ledger holds.
- A ledger with no records renders a page that says so rather than failing.

## Requirements

- No engine import, no third-party package, no network, no subprocess, and no syntax newer than Python 3.9.
- The page is one file: no linked stylesheet, no script tag, no external font or image.
- Every figure on the page is read from the ledger, never estimated.
payload.title: let the kit write the static board and graph its spec already owes
